name: v8-r10-ic-shrink
description: Cell R-10 (Ruling E-38 slot 49: runs only if R-6 is accepted, else registered for v9): composition ic-shrink-v1 (lane COMB2, task-R-10-report.md; every constant fixed blind before any read). Inside each theme, member weights proportional to a James-Stein shrunk IC estimate: ic_k = the fitter's admission train_mean (the parent fit window; no new window, no new read), shrunk_k = .5 x theme mean + .5 x ic_k (intensity .5 toward the theme's equal weight), floored at 0, a theme with no positive value at equal shares; theme share 1/T and member cap 1/(2T) as in ew-theme-std-v1; the IC runner's per-date standardisation unchanged (theme_standardise rule ic-shrink-v1, its weights verified against the recorded ICs to 1e-12). Ruling E-44: R-10 runs on the last accepted parent, and the fit flag derives the rule from its composition: ew-theme-std-v1 gets ic-shrink-v1; ew-theme-std-aim-v1 (R-3 on R-1) gets the variant ic-shrink-aim-v1 (fix round 1): the shrunk shares times the parent's per-member aim gains inside each theme, renormalised so each theme keeps 1/T, then the 1/(2T) cap (the E-27a mechanism, composition_rules.tier_weights; the runner verifies it with the recorded gains). Ruling E-45: R-10 is defined only on a standardised parent (rerank-true theme_standardise, R-1 accepted), so every other parent composition (ew-theme-v1 of B0c, ew-theme-aim-v2 of R-3 on B0c, ew-theme-v6, ...) refuses at load; if R-1 is rejected R-10 is skipped as undefined. Ruling E-28's 3,072 MiB w pass is set here (runner.phases.w.max_rss_mib, ic.w_flags --max-memory-mib), the same values R-1 sets. Downstream outputs renamed (fit, card, w, nav, monitor); the u pass is the parent's. Identity (code, before the cell): gtests CompositionV8.IcShrinkRunsTheStandardisationUnchangedAndRecordsItsRule and CompositionV8.IcShrinkAimRunsTheStandardisationUnchangedAndRecordsItsRule and the fitter's flag-absent test. Acceptance: paired S2 net dSR > 0 against the parent AND mechanics AND turnover per unit gross (executed: tau_gmv_mean / mean_gross_leverage_all_rows, S2) not higher than the parent (the composition-cell criterion of R-1, plan 12.1; Ruling PM5-11).
